text: The Chair of the Maintaining Housing Working Group will provide an update and share the outcomes of the group’s consultation on Toronto’s proposed renovictions by-law.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the City Clerk to send the Housing Rights Advisory Committee's feedback to City Council for consideration with the report from the Chief Building Official and Executive Director, Toronto Building on Item PH16.4 - Implementing a Rental Renovation License Bylaw to Address Renovictions.
